title: Review user access and privileged accounts
summary: On a recurring security cadence and after significant team or system changes. A reviewed access register with unnecessary privileges removed and exceptions owned.
outcomes: A reviewed access register with unnecessary privileges removed and exceptions owned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: On a recurring security cadence and after significant team or system changes.

parts.title: Collect current identities and entitlements
parts.guidance: Export authorized account, role, service-account and privileged-access information from the relevant systems. Reconcile it with current workers, vendors and system owners without including raw credentials.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Validate business need with accountable owners
parts.guidance: Each system or data owner checks whether access is still needed at its current level. Identify departed users, shared accounts, dormant access and temporary privileges that have no approved expiry.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Validate business need with accountable owners

parts.title: Approve removals and controlled exceptions
parts.guidance: The designated approvers review proposed changes, operational dependencies and emergency access. Assign owners and expiry dates to exceptions rather than allowing a reviewer to approve their own unnecessary privilege.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Apply and verify the authorized changes
parts.guidance: Administrators remove or adjust approved access and rotate exposed credentials through the established process. Test critical service accounts and preserve company-controlled recovery paths.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Apply and verify the authorized changes

parts.title: Reconcile evidence and the next review
parts.guidance: Compare the approved decisions with actual entitlements and log unresolved changes. Retain the review evidence, assign remediation owners and schedule the next review.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A reviewed access register with unnecessary privileges removed and exceptions owned.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting.
